objective: Auditar y definir el alcance funcional exacto del modulo Tablajeria EDARSAHUB, tomando como base la arquitectura canonica Gate0 ya certificada y la verdad operativa del proceso de conversion de un insumo base a multiples derivados. Solo READ_ONLY. No publicar Gate2. No tocar Produccion. No modificar backend ni frontend.

context.gate0_status: Gate0 R2 certificado READ_ONLY / PASS por evidencia previa
context.functional_domain: Tablajeria es el proceso operativo donde un insumo base comprado o existente en inventario, por ejemplo lonja, pieza primaria o canal, se transforma en multiples insumos derivados, por ejemplo cortes, subproductos, merma y desperdicio.

queries.name: schema_tablajeria_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR o.name LIKE '%tablaj%' OR o.name LIKE '%Talla%' OR o.name LIKE '%talla%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name;

queries.name: schema_canonical_domain_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Producto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Invent%' OR o.name LIKE '%Operacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Almacen%' OR o.name LIKE '%Lote%' OR o.name LIKE '%Costo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Compra%' OR o.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR o.name LIKE '%Movimiento%' OR o.name LIKE '%Receta%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name;

queries.name: schema_relevant_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE, c.IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c WHERE c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Producto%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Invent%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Operacion%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Almacen%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Lote%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Costo%' OR c.TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Compra%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Rendimiento%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Merma%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Subproducto%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Costo%' OR c.COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Lote%' ORDER BY c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.ORDINAL_POSITION;

queries.name: schema_relevant_foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS foreign_key_name, OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_schema, OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table, OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema, OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Producto%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Invent%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Operacion%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Almacen%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Lote%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Costo%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Compra%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Producto%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Invent%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Operacion%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Almacen%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Lote%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Costo%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) LIKE '%Compra%' ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_table, foreign_key_name;

queries.name: schema_relevant_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(i.object_id) AS schema_name, OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique FROM sys.indexes i WHERE OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Producto%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Invent%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Operacion%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Almacen%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Lote%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Costo%' OR OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) LIKE '%Compra%' ORDER BY schema_name, table_name, index_name;

queries.name: schema_rbac_permissions_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = o.schema_id WHERE o.name LIKE '%Permiso%' OR o.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR o.name LIKE '%RBAC%' OR o.name LIKE '%Modulo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Autoriz%' OR o.name LIKE '%Usuario%' ORDER BY s.name, o.name;

queries.name: schema_sql_modules_references
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(m.object_id) AS schema_name, OBJECT_NAME(m.object_id) AS module_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.sql_modules m INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = m.object_id WHERE m.definition LIKE '%Tablaj%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Invent%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Producto%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Lote%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Costo%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Compra%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Rendimiento%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Merma%' ORDER BY schema_name, module_name;

success_criteria: Alcance funcional V1 claro y auditable
Sin proponer duplicacion de entidades canonicas
Gate2 permitido solo si no hay blockers
